preconditions.description: The size of the first part of the bipartite graph must be between 1 and 1000.
The size of the second part of the bipartite graph must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of edges in the graph must be between 0 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= a and 1 <= y <= b for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect vertices within the valid range of the two parts of the bipartite graph.

postconditions.description: The minimal number of colours required for edge painting in a bipartite graph is always 2.
The number of colours output must match the number of edges in the input.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= colour <= c for colour in colours)
postconditions.description: All output colours must be within the range of 1 to the minimal number of colours used.

candidate_issues.instruction: Replace the expression to reflect the correct minimal number of colors for edge painting in a bipartite graph.
candidate_issues.task_evidence: You are given an undirected bipartite graph without multiple edges. You should paint the edges of graph to minimal number of colours, so that no two adjacent edges have the same colour.

candidate_issues.instruction: Add a postcondition to ensure the output colors correspond to the edges in the input order.
candidate_issues.task_evidence: The second line should contain m integers from 1 to c — the colours of the edges (in the order they appear in the input).
